avis.texte: I have put this on 3 times, and it has pilled all 3 times. I love the texture. I love the way that it feels when applying. But I can't have constant pilling all day. The first day I wore it, I thought it was just dry skin under my makeup. Yesterday, I didn't wear makeup and thought it was dry skin again. Today, it was obvious pilling, no makeup.

Bought this on a whim without any review, its amazing. I think it has also helped my acne a great deal and it feels great to the touch. This [soon to be] and colorescience sunscreen are the only products I constantly use fully and repeat buy
I love this for my extremely oily skin. It keeps it at bay while providing some moisture. This would probably be too drying if you have dry skin/texture.

avis.titre: Wouldn't go out of my way to purchase
avis.texte: I dont hate or love the product feels nice going on but instantly absorbs in the skin leaving me to feel drier, if i add a face oil to it its better

Perhaps I'm just not the ideal consumer for this product … I introduced this sorbet gel to my skincare routine about twice a week, with no other new products so as not to disturb its efficacy. My skin feels tight and dry following application, to the point of appearing red and splotchy. This sorbet offers absolutely no soothing effect. It feels as if I have just applied a harsh salicylic acid toner. Considering all the stellar reviews, I seem to be the outlier. I have tried other hydrating gels that provide much needed relief to parched skin. This product just isn't it.

I have a lot of particulars when it comes to texture of stuff I put on my skin, and this has to be my favorite. It leaves my skin soft and more importantly hydrated! I have terribly dry skin to the point where it makes all of the foundations I've ever tried inevitably flake and get patchy, but this fixed that! It absorbs easily and quite frankly, fun to play with. I'll happily buy this again.

I have always had combo oily skin and for years I've been searching for a moisturizer that actually controls oil. THIS IS IT! This moisturizer controls oil, keeps the shine away all day and night, and my face has never felt softer. LOVE

I have been using this product daily for the past month and my skin has never been better! My pores seem diminished in size and appearance, my skin looks brighter and more youthful. I have sensitive skin and so far, I've had no reaction or irritation at all.

avis.titre: "Mineral 89"  Sorbet Mat Hydration Global User's Stars
avis.texte: "Mineral 89" Sorbet Mat Hydration Global User's Stars Of Preferably Products.

avis.titre: Silky, Lightweight Hydration That Doubles as the Perfect Pri
avis.texte: I recently tried Minéral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet, and it's a game-changer for my skincare and makeup routine! This lightweight gel formula glides on effortlessly and sets to a silky matte finish without clumping or feeling slimy when it dries. It's fragrance-free, which is a huge plus for my sensitive skin, and it provides gentle, long-lasting cooling that feels amazing throughout the day. As a bonus, it works beautifully as a foundation primer, creating a smooth base for makeup. The packaging is sleek, and the product size is quite reasonable for the price. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for an effective, gentle moisturizer that doubles as a primer!

First of all, I love that this is unscented! No old lady floral scent is a huge plus for me. I also wasn't sure if like the matte finish but it's not drying at all. A little bit goes a long way and it melts into my skin and leaves a perfect canvas for applying foundation. I rub the leftover product on the back of my hands and they look so much smoother! Definitely a product I will reach for over all the others.

I waited to submit my review so I can give authentic review. This product helps keep my skin moisturized and bouncy. I recommend this product for more mature skin but overall any person can use is cream and benefit from it.

I received the Vichy Mineral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet from Vichy in return for my honest review. After using this product for 3 weeks now, I can say I absolutely love it and will recommend to anyone who is looking for a lightweight, melt-in-your-skin moisturizer. When you open the container it has very faint scent, almost undetectable. The texture is gel-like, very soft, and just a little bit goes a long way. Once on the face the texture is light but there is still substance, which absorbs effortlessly and also maintains hydration throughout the day. The formula leaves a comfortable, shine-free, and non-greasy finish. I felt a cooling effect, and for the first couple of uses I also felt a slight tingle on my face, which usually happens when I use products that contain Hyaluronic Acid. My face has gotten so much softer since using this moisturizer. It's recommended to use in the morning and night, but I admit I sometimes skip the evening routine. I do love using it in the morning for the plump effect it gives. Another area I have been using any leftover product after applying on my face and neck, is my elbows. An unusual and almost forgotten area in our bodies, which needs a little extra hydration some times. I can say that in a matter of days they became so soft and hydrated, it's almost unbelievable! After using this moisturizer, it convinced me to purchase other Vichy products, which I have also liked.
I love how hydrating and moisturizing this was. It gave a beautiful finish and glow!

This is such an interesting product. It is a gel like feeling but it starts off as shiny on your skin, once it has dried (2-3 minutes after putting it on) it turns matte and it is so beautiful on the skin! works great under foundation and other face makeup.

I like how this is mattifying for my skin. Some days I'll just keep this one with a light liner and a quick lip gloss and I'm ready for the day. Not sure how well it moisturizes as I used other products in junction of this, but I'll keep using until it's empty

avis.titre: does what it says it will
avis.texte: The texture of this is something different I have noticed more hydration products coming out with and I am a fan! Fragrance free, looks great under makeup & not sticky! My skin gets dry in the winter and this sorbet helps my skin feel more plump and hydrated. I am looking forward to using it all winter. :)
This moisturizer is Fantastic. I love how it leaves my skin Dewey without being shiny. The matte finish is great, and it gives just the right amount of moisture.
Great moisturizing without leaving greasy skin. I apply daily and it's easy become part of my daily skin care routine. I got this complimentary of Vicky and I'm planning con buying a backup.

avis.titre: Matte Moisturizer Something Different in Skin Care
avis.texte: It was very interesting open up my jar to reveal a matte moisturizer. I paired this with my normal serum and applied a generous amount before bed. I woke up the next day and my skin still felt really hydrated. I tried it the next night without my serum and it dried up on my skin fairly quickly. I found this works better paired with a serum in order to get the long hydrating times the sorbet states. This is best used as a day moisturizer because the matte did help fill in my pores before I put makeup on

I absolutely love Minéral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet! It's a fantastic product that offers a refreshing burst of hydration while keeping my skin feeling soft and smooth. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue behind, and the matte finish is perfect for my oily skin. It keeps my skin balanced, hydrated, and shine-free throughout the day. It works well with my other skin care products.

After my daily skin care routine, I apply this sorbet to moisturize my skin. I usually suffer from dry flaky skin by the end of the day. I noticed that this kept my skin from drying out for 24 hours. I was not able to make it through the whole 48 hours without having to reapply, but I'm sure there will different reactions to different skin types.
I LOVE this product. I have combination skin and it works great. Very light, smooth application. Keeps my skin moisturized all day. Has become a new staple in my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Will be buying again and again
avis.texte: As someone with mature skin I really liked Vichy mineral 89 48h moisture matte sorbet. I skin felt moisturized all day without feeling greasy or weighed down. Works great under makeup with no pilling. I did receive a sample but all opinions are my own.

I was introduced to Vichy brand quite a time ago and had always a positive and good experience, I have a combination skin that requires a smart moisturizer that would not get my face looking greasy, sorbet mat hydration is perfect with no scent at all that is easy to apply and it observes gradually and give you a clean and clear look, I like it because it balances my pores and provide confidence through the day, highly recommend this trusted brand.

This moisturizer is super light, yet it hydrates so well! I received this product in exchange for a review, but I will be purchasing it again! I was pleasantly surprised by how long lasting this product is given how light it is, and it's not at all greasy!

avis.titre: Refreshing Relief: The Ultimate Moisturizer for Hot Flashes
avis.texte: Vichy Laboratories kindly gave me the Mineral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet for free so that I could review it. This moisturizer offers a refreshing, cooling effect that is particularly beneficial during hot flashes, making it a new staple in my skincare routine.The gel consistency is light and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated without any greasiness. After using it, my skin feels renewed and perfectly balanced. I genuinely love this product and highly recommend it to anyone seeking effective hydration with a matte finish. Vichy has truly delivered with this exceptional moisturizer.

I have been pleasantly surprised about this moisturizer. The formula is lightweight and silky feeling on my skin. There's no greasy feeling and it absorbs into my skin really well. I'm looking forward to seeing how it does long term, but as of now, I'd get this again.

This is unlike any gel moisturizer I've used before. I'm a fan of light moisturizers, but need them to actually hydrate my skin. It goes on silky smooth, hydrates my skin without being oily, and the best part - looks amazing under my makeup. No caking or flaking! It has a cooling sensation which I love, but it's not overpowering. Definitely recommend!
I love the luxe packaging and the luxe product inside! Gives long lasting hydration with a matte finish on my combination skin. Doesn't leave any sort of cast and absorbs like a dream

I enjoy using this product! Its lightweight and airy when applying. I love how it provides hydration to my skin without the greasy or sticky feeling. I also use this under my makeup and it works perfectly! It does have a very light fragrance which doesnt bother me at all. Now my skin will stay hydrated 48Hrs.

I love how this doesn't just sit on top of my skin, this absorbs fast. This moisturizer is a gel formula that agrees so well with my oily skin, it doesn't clog my pores or feel sticky. There little to no scent. I highly reccomend.

Gel moisturizer isn't normally my first choice after trying another brand that left my skin feeling dry. I'm so glad I gave it another chance with this 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet! The texture is silky and reminiscent of primers I've used, but without containing silicones. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and matte, and wears really well under makeup. The cooling effect is subtle and welcome living in a hot climate.

Vichy matte sorbel gel is amazing!! This gel goes on smooth and absorbs nicely. You can use it all year round. Feels so good on my skin. It's cooling and I love how it make my skin feel. It literally is like sorbet on youe skin. Provides 48 moisture and I couldn't love this any more!!! So good for your skin!!!
I love how light the Minéral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet is. It goes on so smooth and leaves my skin moisturized all day.
I really loved this! It has a really nice light texture. It didn't cause any redness even when used on my under eye area.

Omgosh I love this product so much! Is velvety smooth when applying to your face so I can see why they call it sorbet. It has a very light scent which is really nice. It really made my face feel more moisturized.

I'm really enjoying this product! It's so light and airy in its application. It keeps my skin soft and smooth all day. I apply my makeup over it with no issues. It also has no scent which I appreciate. I love this as part of my skincare routine now!

My combination skin is challenging because one product does not usually work all over. BUT, this sorbet from Vichy is an incredible solution. It mositurizes where needed, but does not leave my skin feeling greasy or sticky, like some products do. I also love the delivery system. The gel is very refreshing (I can see this being amazing in the summer). And it absorbs quickly and thoroughly. I can put my makeup on just a few minutes after using, which I appreciate in the morning. And, I am a bit sensitive to scents. I really can't use anything that is too highly perfumed. But this has a very light, pleasant fragrance - a little like fresh linen - very subtle. 100% recommend this for anyone with combination skin.

avis.titre: Hydration Heaven in a Jar – and It's a Matte Finish Miracle!
avis.texte: Let me tell you, the Vichy Minéral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet is like having a tiny spa in a jar that's 100% dedicated to making my combination skin look freakishly flawless. This stuff hydrates without a hint of greasiness, so my face no longer has that 3 p.m. shine that practically announces, "Look, I've just done a cardio workout!" The texture is like this dreamy, cool sorbet that vanishes into my skin faster than my self-control around ice cream. I'm not sure what sorcery Vichy put in this, but my face stays so soft and balanced, I'd almost swear it's finally decided to stop being temperamental. And the best part? It's fragrance-free, which means zero surprises for sensitive days when my skin is ready to riot at the smallest excuse. This little gem keeps me hydrated for 48 glorious hours, so even if I forget to reapply (because, you know, life happens), I don't get the midday dry-patch surprise. It's hands down a forever staple for me – I've even given it prime real estate in my bathroom cabinet.

Living in a dry climate especially during the cold months, my skin gets super dry. I love to use this moisturizer cream in my evening routine and my skin feels so soft and plump in the morning. My makeup applies super smoothly in the morning. I highly recommend this product. The smell isn't my favorite but it's not the worst either.

I've been loving the Vichy Minéral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet! As someone with combination skin, finding a moisturizer that hydrates without leaving me shiny has been a challenge, but this one is perfect. The lightweight gel texture melts into my skin and leaves it feeling so soft and matte all day. It's like getting the hydration my skin craves without the greasy aftermath. I've noticed that it even has a cooling effect when I apply it, which is such a refreshing bonus. And the fact that it keeps my skin hydrated for up to 48 hours while also giving me a shine-free finish is a game-changer. Plus, it works so well under makeup! No pilling, no flaking—just smooth, hydrated skin that stays matte. It's officially a staple in my skincare routine!

I got this product to test for review. I got dry skin, however the moisturizing level is just perfect for my morning use, when I need to apply makeup. At night I may need a heavier moisturizer. This would be perfect for oily skin.

avis.titre: Worth adding to the skincare arsenal
avis.texte: I've used this cream as my night cream for the last week and have been really impressed! It kept my skin moisturized without making it greasy, which is not an easy task in the dry climate where I live. The consistency is really light, like a more substantial gel moisturizer. A little bit goes a long way, and I'm able to cover my face and neck with just a finger-dip worth! I don't think it would be heavy enough for me in the winter, but I think people in higher/normal humidity levels would do well with it. It's a gorgeous moisturizer! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I have been using the same moisturizer for the last few years and I was adamant about not switching because it's worked wonders for my combination skin. But this product has changed my mind. If you have oily or combination skin, this is the product for you. Not only is it not greasy, it leaves your skin feeling so moisturized. I purposely washed my face in the morning and then skipped my evening routine and didn't wash it again until the following morning and my skin felt amazing. I tend to get oily in my t-zone and dry everywhere else. My oily areas weren't oily and my dry areas were nice and moisturized. I love this product. I will definitely buy in the future.

avis.titre: The moisture your skin is craving
avis.texte: I didn't realize how thirsty my skin was! This skin cream instantly disappeared into my skin and left it hydrated. This color and consistency was a bit off putting. I expected something less opaque and jelly like. However my skin seemed to enjoy the hydration.

I received this free in exchange for my honest review. This Mineral 89 48 hour Moisture Matte Sorbet from Vinchy is exactly what my face needed. It leaves my face feeling soft and smooth, not greasy. It just takes a small dab to use on my face and rubs in fully, leaving no trace at all. I use this every morning and night without fail now and I can honestly say how pleased I am with it. It has no scent so unless you saw me putting it on, you would never know I did, but my face would and that is what matters.

I love the Mineral 89 48H Moisture Matte Sorbet. I have oily combination skin, and this cream does a great job of moisturizing my skin overnight without any heaviness. My skin looks glowing and smooth in the morning, making it very suitable for this dry season.
This product feels nice going on your skin. No scent. Rubs In easily however it says it's for combination to oily skin and I have more dry skin so it's not enough moisture for me.

This product can be used AM or PM, under makeup or by itself. It provides a great moisture with a pretty matte finish. I didn't feel like it was overbearing, it was the perfect amount of moisture. There is no scent to the product which I like since I have acne prone skin. Which it also didn't cause any new breakouts which I appreciate.

avis.titre: Keeps my skin moisturized all day long
avis.texte: This product is amazing for all skin types but if you have dry skin, this is a great product to try as it keeps your skin moisturized and soft all day long and I love applying it daily as the base of my makeup. If you have oily skin, this is still a great option for you because it has matte finish so even though it keeps your skin hydrated and soft but your skin doesn't feel or look oily.

This has a lovely light, sorbet-like texture that feels refreshing and absorbs quickly—no sticky feeling at all! After just a week of using it, my skin feels smoother and looks more plump. Plus, I love the matte finish — it really keeps my T-zone from getting oily throughout the day. It's full of volcanic water and hyaluronic acid, which is a great perk. Plus, I really like that it doesn't have any parabens or artificial fragrances, especially since my skin tends to be sensitive. Overall, this product has quickly become a must-have in my skincare routine. I highly recommend it if you're in search of a lightweight moisturizer that provides hydration while maintaining a matte appearance.

I love how luxe this moisturizer feels at a reasonable price point. I find that it really does give me long-lasting hydration without making my face look like a greasy mess or moving around under my makeup. The salicylic acid keeps my skin clear as well!! New favorite
Smells great, absorbs nicely. Love the heavy weight of the jar!

I got this on sale or for free as a gift with purchase (I cant exactly remember but its not what I sought out to buy and got it with my order) and as someone with oily skin with visible pores its hard to find good moisturizers that wont irritate the skin and clog pores. Works well no shine slightly mattifying effect and its light weight. Use more often than some of my more costly products.

M34 I've been using it for a couple of weeks now and the product does what it says. It mattifies without over-drying. My skin is very sensitive and it hasn't broken me out. It glides on the skin and is a thick formula. Almost feels like silicone, but then it soaks into the skin nicely instead of sitting on top.
